title: OpenAI Concludes $7 Billion Share Buyback Ahead of Potential IPO: Report

OpenAI has reportedly completed a deal to help employees sell nearly $7 billion worth of the company's shares ahead of its potential IPO.

The Sam Altman-led company repurchased shares from existing as well as former employees rather than relying on external investors for the tender offer, Bloomberg reported on Monday. The startup's valuation remained unchanged at $852 billion following the deal.

OpenAI did not immediately respond to Benzinga's request for comments.

Read Also:EXCLUSIVE: The 75% of AI Workloads That May Not Need OpenAI or Anthropic

OpenAI Reportedly Delays IPO

Secondary sales have been a critical aspect of the ChatGPT maker's strategy in the run-up to its initial offering. In October, the company completed a $6.6 billion tender offer at a $500 billion valuation, following a $1.5 billion tender offer in 2024.

In June, the company confidentially filed its prospectus with the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC), but hasn't shared any official timeline for its IPO. However, some reports later suggested that the company may push back the date until 2027.

According to PitchBook, OpenAI CFO Sarah Friar favored waiting until 2027, while Altman was more keen on a September 2026 listing with a $1 trillion valuation. The research firm stated that the market activity around Space Exploration Technologies Corp.'s (NASDAQ:SPCX) public debut spurred concerns over investor reactions to a large-scale tech listing.

As the company moves closer to its IPOs, investors are expected to scrutinize the issues SpaceX faces, which are whether massive capital expenditure can translate into sustainable profits and whether private-market valuations can continue to stand its ground under public-market scrutiny.

据报道，OpenAI 已完成一项交易，帮助员工在其潜在的 IPO 之前出售价值近 70 亿美元的公司股票。

据彭博社周一报道，山姆·奥尔特曼领导的公司从现有和前任员工手中回购了股票，而不是依赖外部投资者进行要约收购。 交易完成后，该初创公司的估值保持在 8520 亿美元不变。

OpenAI 没有立即回应 Benzinga 的置评请求。

据报道 OpenAI 推迟了 IPO

在首次发行之前，二次销售一直是 ChatGPT 制造商战略的一个重要方面。 继 2024 年完成 15 亿美元的要约收购后，该公司于 10 月以 5000 亿美元的估值完成了 66 亿美元的要约收购。

6 月，该公司向美国证券交易委员会 (SEC) 秘密提交了招股说明书，但尚未透露任何 IPO 的官方时间表。 不过，后来有报道称该公司可能会将日期推迟到 2027 年。

据 PitchBook 报道，OpenAI 首席财务官 Sarah Friar 倾向于等到 2027 年，而 Altman 则更热衷于 2026 年 9 月上市，估值为 1 万亿美元。 该研究公司表示，围绕太空探索技术公司（纳斯达克股票代码：SPCX）首次公开募股的市场活动引发了人们对投资者对大规模科技上市反应的担忧。

随着该公司距离首次公开募股（IPO）越来越近，预计投资者将密切关注 SpaceX 面临的问题，即巨额资本支出能否转化为可持续利润，以及私募市场估值能否在公开市场审查下继续站稳脚跟。
